name: Pine Labs Ltd
title: Pine Labs Ltd - 544606 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY27 revenue guided at 21–23.5% (hard guide) versus ~19% in FY26, with Q4 hit by POS chip-shortage delays of ~2 lakh machines; capex run-rate Rs180–190 Cr, contribution margin 73–74% in Q4.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competition is backing off from the POS and infrastructure market, with newcomers pulling out of petroleum segment terminals.
capex.quote: the run rate of capex is about Rs.180 Crores to Rs.190 Crores which remains

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 21–23.5%
triggers.quote: we have given out a hard guidance when it comes to revenues. We think we will be able to grow at about 21% to 23.5%
triggers.highlight: hard guidance when it comes to revenues

triggers.label: Competitors pulling back in POS/OMC
triggers.quote: We are getting to see the newbies in this business actually pull out of it because it is just not economically viable for them
triggers.highlight: newbies in this business actually pull out of it

triggers.label: Working capital cut to 45 days
triggers.quote: the working capital cycle from a 60 -day cycle to now a 45 -day cycle

triggers.label: Affordability take rate 35→30 bps (blended)
triggers.quote: the take rates were as high as 35 bps in t he quarter before and now it has gone down to 30 bps
triggers.highlight: take rates were as high as 35 bps

guidance.quote: We think we will be able to grow at about 21% to 23.5% on a year -on-year basis as far as revenue is concerned

guidance.metric: Adjusted EBITDA conversion from incremental contribution
guidance.quote: So 55 it is a number that we feel super confident that we will not be able to miss.
there could be 2% to 3% up and down, which can happen when it comes to contribution margin

red_flags.label: OCF flattered by bill discounting / factoring
red_flags.quote: we have resorted to bill discounting that has improved the receivables collections, driving Rs.202 Crores in early settlement related cash inflows this quarter

red_flags.label: Q4 OCF Rs676 Cr not standalone
red_flags.quote: I am going to be the first one to tell you that this Rs.676 Crores should not be looked at on a standalone basis

red_flags.label: Q4 POS deployment slip from chip shortage
red_flags.quote: There was a time in Q4 where we had a backlog running of almost 2 lakh POS machines which we had to deploy in the market and which got delayed

evasions.quote: We have not been keen to show that in detail right now
it is very difficult to guide
I am not actually giving a guidance on that one
